Some thoughts on supply orders for anyone flying with an animal
What you should know comes first

Supply orders for animal travel

If you are arranging a trip with Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk can help you keep the supply side of the journey calm and simple. The aim is to make sure your animal has the items it needs, and that the crew can handle the journey with care from start to finish.

Before you travel, check that your supplies are packed in a way that is easy to inspect and easy to reach. Keep food, water, wipes, and any approved comfort items together if the animal will need them during the trip. A clean and familiar setup can make a real difference for a pet like Miso, especially when the airport feels busy.

The team gives practical guidance to crews so that each animal gets patient attention on the day of travel. If something changes, the staff can adjust the plan and keep the handoff smooth. When a traveler feels unsure, the supervisors listen closely and try to reduce stress without delay.

If you need to escalate a transfer, <<FACT F106>>. After that step, continue to follow the instructions given by the desk so the order stays consistent and nothing important gets missed. It helps to keep your documents and supply list in one place, since that makes check-in much easier for everyone involved.

Some travelers also like to note any small habits that help their animal stay settled, such as a preferred blanket or a calmer way of being carried. These details can be shared with the desk in plain language. The more clearly you describe the animal's needs, the better the team can support the trip.

For the smoothest experience, check that all travel items are in good condition and that nothing fragile can spill or open in transit. If a supply order needs attention or you feel uncertain at any step, the Companion Animal Travel Desk can provide more help.
